title: LC Hotels
description: A Lightman's Currency Expansion Mod that adds Hotels to Minecraft
body:
# LC Hotels

A comprehensive hotel management addon for Lightman's Currency!

Build and manage hotels, rent rooms to players, and create a thriving hospitality business on your Minecraft server.

\---

##  📋 Overview

LC Hotels extends Lightman's Currency with a complete hotel management system. Players can build hotels, set room prices, rent rooms to guests, and earn passive income. Guests receive keycards that grant access to their rooms and hotel amenities.

**Requires**: \[Lightman's Currency\](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lightmans-currency)

\---

✨ Features

 🏨 Hotel Management  
\- \*\*Hotel Controller\*\* - The brain of your hotel. Manages rooms, staff, pricing, and collects payments into a hotel bank  
\- Front Desk- Where guests can browse available rooms, rent rooms, extend stays, and check out  
\- Room Signs - Display room status (Available/Occupied) and guest names automatically

🚪 Door System  
\- Keycard Doors - Secure room doors that only open for guests with valid keycards  
\- Conference Doors - For meeting rooms and event spaces  
\- Amenity Doors - Control access to hotel facilities:  
  - 🏊 Pool  
  - 💪 Gym  
  - 💆 Spa  
  - 🍽️ Restaurant  
  - 🍸 Lounge  
  - 🅿️ Parking  
  - 🌅 Rooftop (Staff Only)

 🎫 Keycard System  
\- Room Keycards - Given to guests upon rental, includes hotel name, room, and expiration  
\- Guest Keys - Guests can create duplicate keys for friends/party members (configurable limit)  
\- Master Keycard - Hotel owners get a key that opens all doors  
\- Visual Tooltips - Keycards show remaining time with color-coded urgency

 👥 Staff System  
\- Staff Members - Can manage rooms and assist guests  
\- Co-Owners - Full hotel access including withdrawing funds  
\- Permissions are checked at doors and the controller

 🎯 Amenity Access Control  
\- Configure which room types have access to which amenities  
\- Standard rooms might get pool access, while Suites get everything  
\- Room types: Standard, Deluxe, Suite, Penthouse  
\- Conference types: Small, Medium, Large, Ballroom

⚙️ Highly Configurable  
\- Rental day length (Minecraft days or custom tick values)  
\- Time display format (Rental Days, Real Time, or Minecraft Days)  
\- Min/max rental periods  
\- Early checkout refunds (configurable percentage)  
\- Auto-closing doors  
\- Max keys per room  
\- Price limits  
\- And more!

\---

 🎮 How It Works

 For Hotel Owners:  
1\. Place a Hotel Controller and name your hotel  
2\. Create rooms in the controller GUI (set room number, type, and price)  
3\. Place Keycard Doors and link them to rooms using the Room Linker  
4\. Place Amenity Doors and link them to the hotel  
5\. Set up a Front Desk for guest self-service  
6\. Configure which amenities each room type can access  
7\. Optionally place Room Signs outside doors  
8\. Collect profits from the hotel bank!

For Guests:  
1\. Visit the Front Desk and browse available rooms  
2\. Select a room and rental duration, then pay  
3\. Receive a Keycard that grants access to your room  
4\. Create Guest Keys for friends if needed  
5\. Extend your stay or check out early at the Front Desk  
6\. Enjoy hotel amenities based on your room type!
